transforms.name: adapter-step-0
transforms.effect: monitor.ts writes context, model, effort, and mode only. It never writes a status family update.

transforms.name: adapter-step-1
transforms.effect: AcpPromptService mints turn id acp-turn-N and emits turn:started, turn:completed copying stopReason, outcome interrupted only when stopReason is cancelled, or turn:failed with the error string.

transforms.name: adapter-step-2
transforms.effect: normalizeAcpTool emits tool:started for tool_call, plus completed or failed when that status is set. tool_call_update emits only completed or failed. in_progress emits no tool event.
